Snails by the road
Jul 2025 • Solo
Visited this restaurant in the evening - it is near the waterfront, right by the road. The establishment is quite large, with live seafood tanks at the entrance. The employees were hospitable. The seating is very large, the inside is bright, the setting is simple, without too much decoration. I ordered snails in lemongrass - it's already a classic for me. It wasn't long ago. The dish looked delicious, the snails are served with chili sauce. It tasted really good, the aromatic broth and the pleasant spiciness. The service is unobtrusive, but timely - all delivered quickly and without delay. Cards are accepted.

Good but pricy seafood :-)
Jul 2023 • Family
The main reason we picked this place was because they have separate rooms with air conditioning. 

I suppose the quality of the seafood is a little bit better than other seafood restaurants in DN which I think that is why the price is pricy. 

The service was good, however the food could be prepared and served faster. And the price of the seafood could be more clearer. We got one price before ordering the seafood (crab) and on the bill it said something else afterwards. 

If you want to experience seafood of a little bit higher quality, air conditioned chambres séparées, clean restrooms and have a thick wallet - it is the place. Otherwise I am sure Da Nang have plenty of seafood restaurants with also fresh and delicious seafood of a nice price to offer. Bon appetite! :-)
